items.information: (HR) Croatian Nationals 2023 je natjecanje koje se održava u Petrinji. Bilo tko može sudjelovati, bez obzira na nacionalnost i starost, no svatko mora biti upoznat s WCA Pravilnikom. Natjecanje je pod organizacijom Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska. Kotizacija pokriva trošak organizacije i najma prostora. Mogući višak kotizacije ide u svrhu razvitka Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska. Također, natjecanje je priznato kao Nacionalno Prvenstvo te će se dijeliti nagrade za najbolja 3 Hrvata u svim disciplinama. Za više informacija, proučite ostale kartice na stranici natjecanja. ---- (EN) Croatian Nationals 2023 is a competition held in Petrinja. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations. This competition is being organized by the Speedcubing Association Croatia. Registration fee covers the cost of the organization and venue rental. Any extra money goes directly to support Speedcubing Association Croatia. This competition is also recognized as Croatian National Championship and top 3 Croatians in all events will be additionally awarded, alongside regular podiums. For more information, check other tabs on the competition website.

venue.name: [Kirstenhof Primary School](https://goo.gl/maps/ibUsNtD2otafVyrp9)
venue.address: 18 Lente St, Kirstenhof, Cape Town, 7945, South Africa

items.information: [CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce the third Cape Town competition for 2023. This competition will focus on a variety of shorter, popular events, having multiple rounds of everything, as well as having some attempts of 4BLD and 5BLD in the morning. Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, **and** make an EFT payment to confirm your entry. Please see Registration Requirements below. ### SPECTATORS Competitors are welcome to bring up to **two** spectators with them. ### VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). For 4x4 and 5x5 Blindfolded, which will be in the early morning on both days, we ask for competitors to please reach out to us before the competition to volunteer to be judges during these events. By doing so and helping out, you will earn yourself a free cup of coffee/tea/hot chocolate! ### SPONSORSHIP ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbU10IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--03db2d12875f7b21e073b29649b48a5bc813b0e2/image.png) A big thanks to [Speedcubes](https://www.speedcubes.co.za/) who are sponsoring vouchers as a part of the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to try out and buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. ### LUCKY DRAW During prize-giving after 3x3 Finals on Sunday, we will be having a Lucky Draw for two winners to receive R250 Speedcubes.co.za vouchers each with free shipping on their order! If you needed another reason to stick around and watch 3x3 Finals other than the amazing speed of some of Africa's top speedcubers, maybe you could be one of the lucky winners and walk away with some free cubes or apparel courtesy of our local speedcubing store. #### About CubingZA Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact). We are particularly looking for help with communications, and graphic design.

items.information: **REGISTRO** A participação nesta competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos: 1. Se inscrever através do site da WCA. A inscrição terá custo de R$ 30 e o pagamento deverá ser feito via PIX para a chave planeta.rio.open@gmail.com. O comprovante de pagamento deverá ser enviado para o mesmo email; 2. Escolher os eventos a serem registrados com cuidado após revisar as guias Eventos e Cronograma. Prestar atenção aos formatos das rodadas e seus cortes/limites; 3. Preencher o seguinte [formulário](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd7w5hqTt8BB-GbKildtIHah7ygjYonOWLStzRI10ndMDp8gA/viewform) para facilitar o controle dos nomes dos competidores e acompanhantes por parte da equipe do Planetário envolvida com a organização; 4. Para obterem a entrada e permanência na competição, os **acompanhantes** deverão adquirir os ingressos na bilheteria do Planetário. Cada competidor terá direito a 1 (um) ingresso no valor de meia entrada (R$10) para um acompanhante. Os demais acompanhantes, se houver, deverão pagar o valor inteiro do ingresso (R$20). **Esta taxa é aplicada somente aos acompanhantes** e deverá ser paga apenas nos dias da competição, não devendo ser feita junto a transferência PIX para o pagamento da inscrição; 5. Para informações adicionais, verifique o site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do email planeta.rio.open@gmail.com, bem como o delegado por meio do email isoares@worldcubeassociation.org; 6. Favor ler o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição. **REGISTRATION** The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements: 1. Register through the WCA website. The registration costs R$30 and must be paid via PIX transfer to planeta.rio.open@gmail.com. Proof of payment must be sent to the same email address; 2. Carefully choosing the events. Keep the rounds format, cutoffs and limits in mind; 3. Fill in the following [form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd7w5hqTt8BB-GbKildtIHah7ygjYonOWLStzRI10ndMDp8gA/viewform) to help keep track of competitor and guest names by the Planetarium team involved with the organization; 4. To gain entry and stay in the competition, **guests** must purchase tickets at the Planetarium ticket booth. Each competitor will be entitled to 1 (one) ticket worth half price (R$10) for a single guest. The other guests, if any, must pay the entire ticket price (R$20). **This fee is applied only to guests only** and must be paid only on the days of the competition, and must not be made via the PIX transfer for payment of registration; 5. For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (planeta.rio.open@gmail.com), or the delegate (isoares@worldcubeassociation.org); 6. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.

items.name: BMME 3x3 Day 2023
items.information: ##### *English version is below* #### **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr, euch BMME 3x3 Day 2023 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Florian Truckenthanner und Pranjal Khan und delegiert von Viktor Kalmar. Diesesmal findet das Turnier in den Räumlichkeiten des BMME statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier herzlich willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Da dies ein sehr kleines, ruhiges und auch kurzes Turnier wird sind generell keine Gäste erlaubt (da wir auch von der Räumlichkeit begrenzt sind) - falls jedoch ein Teilnehmer einen Gast dabei haben muss, zb. weil du Minderjährig bist und du deinen Erziehungsberechtigten dabei haben willst, dann schreibt uns bitte noch vor dem Turnier eine E-mail mit einer Begründung und mit dem Namen des Gastes. Generell herrscht absolute Ruhe während des Gesamten Turnieres (ausgenommen von den Pausen) da es sich hauptsächlich um Blind Events sowohl als auch um Fewest Moves handelt. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! ----- #### **English:** We are happy to announce the BMME 3x3 Day 2023 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Florian Truckenthanner and Pranjal Khan and delegated by Viktor Kalmar. The results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. This competition is going to be quite small, short and especially quiet and because of this no guests will be allowed at this competition (also because it is a small room). If you have a good reason why a guest should accompany you (e.g.: you are a minor and you want to have your legal guardian with you), then please let us know before the competition via email (include the name of the guest and the reasoning). It has to be absolutely quiet during the whole competition (except during the breaks) because we mostly have Blind and Fewest Moves events only.

items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ### (EN) ### Registration Reminders Since this is a "favourites" competition, **you may choose at most four (4) events**. You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations and registrations with more than four (4) events will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Mailing List We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand for competitions in southern Ontario and are regularly planning and announcing more competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Competitor Requirements This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, you may want to look at the [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/files/WCA_Competition_Tutorial.pdf). Si vous n'avez jamais participé à une compétition, vous pouvez consulter le [Tutoriel de la compétition de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/files/WCA_Competition_Tutorial.pdf). items.information: English version is below Deutsch: Wir freuen uns sehr euch NÖ Cube Day 2023 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Florian Truckenthanner, Dieter Amberger, Pranjal Khan, David Dinh und delegiert von Viktor Kalmar. Das Turnier findet im Veranstaltungszentrum Z2000 statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! English: We are happy to announce the NÖ Cube Day 2023 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Florian Truckenthanner, Dieter Amberger, Pranjal Khan, David Dinh and is delegated by Viktor Kalmar. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

We are not responsible for no-shows if we begin an event early, and you miss your opprotunity to compete. We need to keep the competition moving along, so we recommend arriving 20-30 minutes before you are scheduled to compete/judge. We may also change the original schedule after competitors register for the competition based on registration numbers for each event, but we will not add or remove full events or change the order of events. At the end of the competition, please pick up any garbage left over and dispose it. This will allow the opportunity that we can use this venue again for more competitions in the future. Tendrán la oportunidad de demostrar sus habilidades, aprender de los mejores y, sobre todo, disfrutar de un día inolvidable rodeados de personas apasionadas como ustedes. In this third edition, we meet once again at the prestigious Teatro Montealegre to celebrate our shared passion for this challenging color puzzle. You will have the opportunity to demonstrate your skills, learn from the best and, above all, enjoy an unforgettable day surrounded by passionate people like you. Whether it's your first time participating in a championship or you're already a veteran solving Rubik's cubes, everyone is welcome!

items.name: Tauranga Open 2023
items.information: Tauranga Open 2023 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

items.information: # Español ¡Bienvenidos al Nayar Open 2023, el **primer torneo oficial** en el hermoso estado de **Nayarit**!. Este evento emocionante y lleno de velocidad se llevará a cabo en la ciudad de Tepic los días 19 y 20 de agosto de 2023. ¡Prepárate para vivir una experiencia única y desafiar tus habilidades en la resolución del cubo Rubik. El Nayar Open 2023 reunirá a cuberos de todo el estado de Nayarit y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en una variedad de modalidades y categorías. Tanto si eres un principiante como un profesional experimentado, este torneo ofrece una oportunidad para que todos participen y se diviertan. Este es el primer torneo organizado por el [Team Nayarit](https://www.facebook.com/rubik.nayarit/). Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. # English Welcome to the Nayar Open 2023, the **first official competition** in the beautiful state of **Nayarit**! This exciting and fast-paced event will take place in the city of Tepic on August 19th and 20th, 2023. Get ready to have a unique experience and challenge your skills in solving the cube. The Nayar Open 2023 will bring together cubers from all over the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them with the opportunity to showcase their dexterity and compete in a variety of modalities and categories. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced professional, this tournament offers a chance for everyone to participate and have fun. This is the first tournament organized by [Team Nayarit](https://www.facebook.com/rubik.nayarit/). This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). items.information: Ōtepoti Winter 2023 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. items.name: Gotland Open 2023
items.information: Välkomna till Gotland Open 2023, den första WCA-tävlingen på Gotland! Tävlingen hålls på Gangvide Farm på Gotlands östkust ca 1 mil söder om Ljugarn. Gangvide farm är ett mysigt ställe där man kan äta färska ägg till frukost och ta ett dopp i ån! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Det blir en 2,5-dagarstävling med alla 17 WCA-grenar. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information, speciellt fliken "resa". *Om du inte tävlar i 4x4 BLD / 5x5 BLD behöver du inte närvara under lördagen* ----- Welcome to Gotland Open 2023, the first WCA competition on the island of Gotland! The competition is held at Gangvide Farm on the east coast of Gotland about 10 km south of Ljugarn. Gangvide Farm is a cozy place where you can eat fresh eggs for breakfast and even take a swim in the river! Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes. It's a 2,5 day competition with all 17 WCA events. Please read all the information tabs because they contain valuable information, especially the travel tab. *If you are not competing in 4x4 BLD / 5x5 BLD you do not need to be present during Saturday.*

items.name: 24 Hours in Flen 2023
items.information: Varmt välkomna till denna 24-timmarstävling i Flen! Precis som vanligt så är alla som önskar varmt välkomna att delta, men vi vill ändå utfärda en kraftig varning kring att tävlingen pågår nonstop i just 24 timmar, och har ett väldigt speciellt koncept. Därför passar tävlingen sannolikt inte varken nya eller yngre deltagare särskilt bra. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida så du inte missar någon viktig information, särskilt fliken **koncept**. Notera också att en sängplats (vandrarhemsstandard) över natten samt frukost ingår i anmälningsavgiften, i samma hus som tävlingen genomförs i. -- A warm welcome to this 24-hour competition in Flen! Just as usual, everyone who wishes is warmly welcome to participate, but we still want to issue a strong warning that the competition runs non-stop for exactly 24 hours, and has a very special concept. Therefore, the competition probably does not suit neither new or younger participants very well. Please read through all the tabs on this page so you don't miss any important information, especially the **concept** tab. Also note that a hostel style bed and breakfast is included in the registration fee, in the same house as the competition will take place in.

A nossa competição é formada por alguns competidores experientes, mas sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. - Caso seja seu primeiro campeonato, assista [este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EFKDwkhPJJE) do Rafael Cinoto; - Favor ler o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) antes da competição; - Divirta-se! ------------------------------------- 🇺🇸 Capixaba Challenge 2023 is the 15th Official Competition of Espírito Santo. It will be a pleasure to receive you and we have some tips for you, competitors and companions: - Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CapixabaChallenge2023/register) tab; - Arrive at the competition venue 30 minutes before the event in which you will participate; - The cube you will be competing in must be in good condition, so take good care of it. Otherwise, the cube may not be accepted for the competition; - If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. items.name: Voula Summer Open 2023
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbUUvIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--25a11a161841639a3cff2ecfb046c27deb82697e/Cubestore_VSO23_post.jpg) Το Voula Summer Open 2023 είναι ο 3oς WCA διαγωνισμός στην Ελλάδα για το 2023. Είμαστε περήφανοι για την πορεία μας φέτος και συνεχίζουμε δυναμικά. Στη σειρά διαγωνισμών "Road to Greek Nationals" εστιάζουμε σε κάθε διαγωνισμό σε 2 events που δεν είναι ακόμα πολύ γνωστά στην Ελλάδα. Σε αυτό το διαγωνισμό θέλουμε να φέρουμε στο ελληνικό κοινό τα αγωνίσματα του One Handed/Λύση με ένα χέρι και του Fewest Move Challenge (FMC)/Δοκιμασία λύσης με τις λιγότερες κινήσεις πιο κοντά στους συμμετέχοντες. Ο στόχος μας είναι να διεξαχθεί το πρώτο εθνικό πρωτάθλημα της Ελλάδας προς το τέλος του τρέχοντος έτους. Μέχρι τότε, όλα τα WCA events θα είναι οικεία στους συμμετέχοντες. Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε στην γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) The Voula Open 2023 is the third competition this year in Greece. We are proud of our progress and we strongly continue our effort. Grab your cubes, get ready, read the rules, and come to the cubing celebration! During each "Road to Greek finals" competition, we focus on 2 events that are not yet very well known in Greece. In this competition we are aiming to bring the events One Handed and Fewest Move Challenge (FMC) closer to the competitors. The goal is to make the first Greek National Championship towards the end of this year. By then, all WCA events will be familiar to the competitors. Grab your cubes, study the regulations and attend the greek feast of cubing! Please read the following tabs very carefully! Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

items.information: Пожалуйста, смотрите наш Инстаграм аккаунт(https://instagram.com/speedcubing_ksf?utm_medium=copy_link). Вся информация и новости по соревнованиям будет в нашем инстаграме. 1. Организаторы не несут ответственности за утерю личных вещей. 2. Мы настоятельно рекомендуем использовать на головоломках отличительные отметки (Внутри кубика или под крышкой детальки) , по которым их легко может идентифицировать владелец. --- После оплаты взноса ваша фамилия появится на сайте. Это означает, что ваша заявка принята. Если вы не оплатили взнос, то примерно за 1 неделю до и непосредственно перед закрытием регистрации вы получите письмо с напоминанием о необходимости оплатить взнос для подтверждения своего участия. Обязательно проверяйте свой ящик и папку СПАМ. Если вы не оплатите взнос, то Ваша заявка не будет принята. Если Вы подали заявку и оплатили взнос, но в течении 2-х рабочих дней ее не подтвердили, сразу обратитесь к организаторам (не считая выходные дни). #### В день соревнований участнику при себе нужно иметь документ удостоверяющий личность. --- Біздің Instagram парақшамызды қараңыз (https://instagram.com/speedcubing_ksf?utm_medium=copy_link). Байқау туралы барлық ақпарат пен жаңалықтар біздің instagram желісінде болады. 1.Жеке заттар жоғалуына ұйымдастырушылар жауапты емес. 2. Пазлдарда ерекше белгілерді пайдалануды ұсынамыз (текшенің ішінде немесе бөліктің мұқабасының астында), белгі арқылы иесі оларды оңай анықтауға мүмкіндік береді. --- Төлемді төлегеннен кейін сіздің аты-жөніңіз сайтта пайда болады. Бұл сіздің өтінішіңіз қабылданғанын білдіреді. Егер сіз жарнаны төлемеген болсаңыз, онда тіркеуден шамамен 1 апта бұрын және тіркеуді жаппас бұрын, сіз өзіңіздің қатысуыңызды растау үшін жарнаны төлеу қажеттілігі туралы ескерту хат аласыз. Міндетті түрде Жәшік пен СПАМ қалтасын тексеріңіз. Егер сіз жарнаны төлемесеңіз, онда сіздің өтініміңіз қабылданбайды. Егер сіз өтінім беріп, жарнаны төлеген болсаңыз, бірақ оны 2 жұмыс күні ішінде растамаған болса, дереу Ұйымдастырушыларға хабарласыңыз (демалыс күндерін есептемегенде). #### Жарыс күні қатысушыда өзімен бірге жеке басын куәландыратын құжат болуы қажет. --- Please see our Instagram account (https://instagram.com/speedcubing_ksf?utm_medium=copy_link). All information and news on the competition will be on our instagram. 1. The organizers are not responsible for the loss of personal belongings. 2. We strongly recommend using distinctive marks on the puzzles (Inside the cube or under the cover of the part), by which the owner can easily identify them. --- After paying the fee, your name will appear on the site. This means that your application has been accepted. If you have not paid the fee, you will receive an email reminding you to pay the fee to confirm your participation approximately 1 week before and immediately before the registration closes. Be sure to check your inbox and SPAM folder. If you do not pay the fee, your application will not be accepted. If you submitted an application and paid the fee, but did not confirm it within 2 working days, immediately contact the organizers (excluding weekends). #### On the day of the competition, the participant must have an identity document with him.

items.information: ##### *English version is below* #### **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr euch Vienna Big Cube Summer 2023 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von David Burany, Florian Truckenthanner, Felix Strasser, Lucas Höglinger, Jeremia Neuhold und delegiert von Bence Barát und Viktor Kalmar. Erneut findet das Turnier im großen Saal der Akkonplatz Pfarre statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! ----- #### **English:** We are happy to announce the Vienna Big Cube Summer 2023 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by David Burany, Florian Truckenthanner, Felix Strasser, Lucas Höglinger, Jeremia Neuhold and delegated by Bence Barát and Viktor Kalmar. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.name: Stockholmsligan Final 2023
items.information: Varmt välkomna till finaltävlingen i vårsäsongen av Stockholmsligan 2023! Mer information om Stockholmligans upplägg finns under fliken med samma namn. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida så du inte missar någon viktig information. Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 18 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Notera dock att varje deltagare denna gång **får välja maximalt fem (5) grenar** att tävla i. **OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen. -- A warm welcome to final competition in the spring season of Stockholmsligan 2023! More information about the league's structure can be found under the tab with the same name. Please read through all the tabs on this page so you don't miss any important information. The competition has a very special format, where each competitor has a total of 18 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. Note, however, that each competitor this time **can choose a maximum of five (5) events** to compete in. **N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition.

Du vil blive kaldt til at lave 5 tidsbestemte løsninger, din bedste tid og værste tider fjernes, og din placering bestemmes af gennemsnittet af de 3 resterende gange! Det eneste du skal bruge er at kunne løse kuben på under 10 minutter, det hjælper vi dig med under workshoppen!

items.information: CubingZA is excited to announce South Africa's 2023 National Championship. Compete against South Africa's fastest speedcubers and break some records! Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, and make payment by buying a ticket on our [Quicket](https://www.quicket.co.za/events/216560-cubingza-national-championship-2023#/) page. # COMPETING This is an open championship - meaning anyone is free to compete. All WCA events except FMC* will be held, with winners in each event being declared the 2023 South African Champion for that event. # SPECTATORS Competitors are allowed to bring up to 2 guests as spectators. Spectators attend for free. # VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at this video. Parents and spectators are welcome to help out with volunteer tasks as well. # SPONSORS Massive thanks to the following sponsors, without whom this competition would not be happening. BMG, who are generously providing their venue at BMG World for the competition, and making Nationals in Joburg a reality. Speecubes.co.za and CubeCo, South Africa's local cube stores, who will be sponsoring prize money and store vouchers for the competition's winners. InsightEdge (Pty) Ltd. has also generously offered to sponsor further prize money towards the winners and podium finishers. *\\*A separate FMC Championship will be held at a later date. This championship will take place simultaneously in multiple locations (CPT, JHB and DBN) to minimise travel requirements.*

Euer Orgateam Welcome to the very first competition in Münster in the history of the WCA! We invite you to a cubing weekend with a colorful mix of events directly at the lake Aasee. Excitement and fun are guaranteed and we keep our fingers crossed for many personal records. We are equally happy to welcome new and familiar faces - if you enjoy cubing, this is the right place for you. See you soon in Münster! Your organization team

items.name: Swedish Championship 2023
items.information: Välkomna till Svenska Mästerskapen 2023! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 7 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Det blir i år en 3-dagarstävling med alla WCA-grenar utom en, 3x3x3 FMC. Den Svenska Mästaren i den grenen kommer krönas på den separata tävlingen [Swedish FMC Championship 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2023). Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. Tävlande av alla nationaliteter är välkomna, men bara deltagare som representerar Sverige kan vinna medaljer, priser och titeln Svensk Mästare. ----- Welcome to the Swedish Championship 2023! Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 7 seconds or 5 minutes. This year there will be a 3-day competition with all WCA events but one, 3x3x3 FMC. The Swedish Champion in this event will be crowned at the separate competition [Swedish FMC Championship 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2023). We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. Competitors of all nationalities are welcome, but only participants representing Sweden can win medals, prizes and the title of Swedish Champion.

items.information: Please read through the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. We highly recommend not bringing any guests. However, we're required to allow 1 guest per competitor. Competitors will be divided into two groups. **Attending the entire competition and judging/scrambling for the group you aren't competing in is mandatory.** You may register to however many events you want, but keep in mind that the combined time limit for finishing your solves is 25 minutes. (e.g. after five 2x2 solves of 10 seconds you have 24:10 left for the remaining events) You may choose the order of the events you compete in. However, you must finish one event before starting a new one. Lue säännöt ([englanniksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), [suomeksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/finnish/)) ennen kilpailua. Suosittelemme saapumaan ilman vieraita. Joudumme kuitenkin sallimaan yhden vieraan per kilpailija. Kilpailijat jaetaan kahteen ryhmään. **Paikallaolo koko kilpailun ajan on pakollista ja sinun täytyy tuomaroida/sekoittaa ryhmässä jossa et kilpaile.** Voit ilmoittautua kuinka moneen lajiin tahansa, mutta pidä mielessä, että kokonaisaikaraja kaikille ratkaisuille on 25 minuuttia. (esim. viiden 10 sekunnin 2x2 ratkaisun jälkeen aikaa lopuille lajeille on 24:10) Voit valita järjestyksen lajeille, joissa kilpailet. Edellinen laji pitää kuitenkin lopettaa ennen seuraavan aloittamista.

items.information: Hjertelig velkommen til vår andre hverdagskubing på LSP i Oslo. Kveldens konkurranse har et veldig spesielt opplegg, der hver deltaker har 18 minutter i total løsningstid til å gjennomføre alle sine løsninger. Det er deltageren selv som på forhånd velger hvilke grener man vil delta i og bruke sine 18 minutter på. Konkurransen foregår mandag kveld og varer i tilsammen ca 4 timer og du kan delta i maks 5 grener. Vi holder til i et lite lokale sentralt i Oslo der LSPkuberne pleier å ha kubetreff. Vi håper at både erfarne og nye speedcubere i Oslo har lyst til å prøve seg på konkurranser lokalt. Vi vil lage månedlige konkurranser framover og se hvilket format som funker. Målet er å starte Osloligaen til høsten, der vi kårer en vinner etter resultatene fra flere små konkurranser gjennom høsten og vinteren. Lokalet er har minimalt med tilskuerplass, så det er fint hvis antall gjester er så lavt som mulig. Konkurransen er sponset av NORDICUBE og SLOAP. -------------------- Welcome to the second edition of LSP Hverdagskubing in Oslo. This competitions has a very special format, where each competitor has a total of 18 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves. The competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. Note, that each competitor can choose a maximum of five (5) events to compete in. The competition, which this time takes place on a Monday, lasts only approx. 4 hours. Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Hverdagskubing") so you don't miss any important information. We are based in a small venue in the center of Oslo where the LSPcubers tend to have cube meetings. We hope that both experienced and new speedcubers in Oslo want to join these local competitions. We will create monthly competitions in the future and see which format works. The aim is to start the Oslo League in the autumn, where we will choose a winner based on the results of several small competitions throughout the autumn and winter. The venue has limited space for guests. Please bring as few guests as possible. The competition is sponsored by NORDICUBE and SLOAP.

items.information: ##### *English version is below* #### **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr euch "Wiener Frühling 2023" als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, David Dinh, Dániel Varga und Felix Strasser und wird delegiert von Bence Barát, Emma Beranová und Viktor Kalmar. Erneut findet das Turnier im großen Saal der Akkonplatz Pfarre statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! ----- #### **English:** We are happy to announce "Wiener Frühling 2023" as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, David Dinh, Dániel Varga, Felix Strasser and is delegated by Bence Barát, Emma Beranová and Viktor Kalmar. The results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations.

items.information: [UA] Змагання проводяться в памʼять про нашого доброго друга, професійного кубера і рекордсмена України — Нікіту Ковальчука (2015KOVA07). items.name: National Capital Region A 2023
items.information: ### (EN) ## NCR 2023 Series This competition is in a series with [National Capital Region B 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NationalCapitalRegionB2023). You will only be able to compete in *one* of these two competitions. Attempting to register for both competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted. ## Mailing List We are aware of the extremely high demand for competitions in Ontario. We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand and are regularly planning and announcing more and larger competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://speedcubingcanada.org/en) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. Thank you for your patience during this time as we work to scale up to the exciting growth of the cubing community. ## Competitor Requirements This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, you may want to look at the [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/files/WCA_Competition_Tutorial.pdf). For new competitors, this video may help with competing. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww&t=2s Please see tabs for more information about the competition. ## Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. ### (FR) ## Série NCR 2023 Cette compétition fait partie d'une série avec [National Capital Region B 2023] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NationalCapitalRegionB2023). Vous ne pourrez participer qu'à *une* de ces deux compétitions. Si vous tentez de vous inscrire aux deux compétitions, une seule de vos inscriptions sera acceptée. ## Liste de diffusion Nous sommes conscients de la demande extrêmement élevée de compétitions en Ontario. Nous travaillons dur pour répondre à cette demande et nous planifions et annonçons régulièrement des compétitions plus grandes et plus nombreuses. Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les médias sociaux et/ou [joindre notre liste de diffusion] (https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. Nous vous remercions de votre patience pendant cette période où nous nous efforçons de faire face à la croissance passionnante de la communauté du cube. ## Exigences pour les compétiteurs Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les concurrents doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Si vous n'avez jamais participé à une compétition, vous pouvez consulter le [Tutoriel de la compétition de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/files/WCA_Competition_Tutorial.pdf). Pour les nouveaux concurrents, cette vidéo peut les aider à participer à la compétition. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww&t=2s Veuillez consulter les onglets pour plus d'informations sur la compétition. ## Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. **ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge. **ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of its events.

items.information: This competition takes place in a large sports convention. Competitors (and parents of competitors) are allowed early entry. Please aim to be there at 9am. If you arrive at 10am, you will not get in by the start of 3x3. Since this is a convention, we will not have dedicated tables for cubers as you would see at many competitions. There will be areas throughout the convention you will be able to hang out and grab tables with others. Because of this, we will be heavily relying on [dropofftable](https://www.dropofftable.com/competition/BayAreaSpeedcubin442023/alerts). Please make sure you are registered with [dropofftable](https://www.dropofftable.com/competition/BayAreaSpeedcubin442023/alerts) before the competition starts. [Dropofftable](https://www.dropofftable.com/competition/BayAreaSpeedcubin442023/alerts) is a texting service that texts you when you are supposed to compete, judge, scramble, or run. * Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors. * Guests must pay for a ticket at the convention ($25). This is not paid to us, this is paid to the convention. You can purchase that at the competition, or online at [https://www.evosportsglobal.com/evo-store/event-tickets](https://www.evosportsglobal.com/evo-store/event-tickets). **Competition Day Timing** - The competition will begin at the scheduled start time. - Lunch will end at the scheduled time. - Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. - Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

items.name: Palmerston North 2023
items.information: Palmerston North 2023 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

items.name: Autotalo All Events 2023

venue.name: Autotalo
venue.details: Salomonkatu main entrance facing the metro station

items.information: Please read through the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. We highly recommend not bringing any guests. However, we're required to allow 1 guest per competitor. Competitors will be divided into two groups. **Attending the entire competition and judging/scrambling for the group you aren't competing in is mandatory.** You may register to however many events you want, but keep in mind that the combined time limit for finishing your solves is 22 minutes. (e.g. after five 2x2 solves of 10 seconds you have 21:10 left for the remaining events) You may choose the order of the events you compete in. However, you must finish one event before starting a new one. Lue säännöt ([englanniksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), [suomeksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/finnish/)) ennen kilpailua. Suosittelemme saapumaan ilman vieraita. Joudumme kuitenkin sallimaan yhden vieraan per kilpailija. Kilpailijat jaetaan kahteen ryhmään. **Paikallaolo koko kilpailun ajan on pakollista ja sinun täytyy tuomaroida/sekoittaa ryhmässä jossa et kilpaile.** Voit ilmoittautua kuinka moneen lajiin tahansa, mutta pidä mielessä, että kokonaisaikaraja kaikille ratkaisuille on 22 minuuttia. (esim. viiden 10 sekunnin 2x2 ratkaisun jälkeen aikaa lopuille lajeille on 21:10) Voit valita järjestyksen lajeille, joissa kilpailet. Edellinen laji pitää kuitenkin lopettaa ennen seuraavan aloittamista.

items.information: ## Registration Reminders Since this is a "favourites" competition, **you may choose at most four (4) events**. You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations and registrations with more than four (4) events will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. Once your registration has been accepted, you will no longer be able to change your events by yourself. If you would like to change them, send the organization team an email and we will change your events for you as long as you inform us before April 1, 2023 at 7:00 PM EDT. ## Mailing List We are aware of the extremely high demand for competitions in Ontario. We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand and are regularly planning and announcing more and larger competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](http://speedcubingcanada.org) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. Thank you for your patience during this time as we work to scale up to the exciting growth of the cubing community. ## Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information: **Deutsch** Wir laden euch herzlich ein zur ersten Competition in **Leipzig** in der Geschichte der WCA. Euch erwartet eine schöne Venue in perfekter zentraler Lage in Leipzig und ein motiviertes Orga-Team. Lasst uns gemeinsam dafür sorgen, dass die Competition **Rahn Education Leipzig** ein traditionelles Event in der WCA wird. **Bitte lies dir alle Tabs sorgfältig durch, damit du mit dem Ablaufplan und allen Modalitäten vertraut bist.** **English** We cordially invite you to the first competition in **Leipzig** in the history of the WCA. After more than 12 years, there is finally a competition in Saxony and we, the organizing team, are looking forward to your numerous appearances. You can expect a beautiful venue in a perfect central location in Leipzig and a motivated organizational team. Let's work together to ensure that the **Rahn Education Leipzig** competition becomes a traditional event in the WCA. **Please read all tabs carefully so you are familiar with the schedule and all modalities.**

Caso contrário, o cubo pode não ser aceito para a competição; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. Otherwise, the cube may not be accepted for the competition.; - If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubists. - Try to have a lot of fun!

items.name: Pickering C 2023
items.information: ## Pickering 2023 Series We are running four competitions as part of the Pickering 2023 Series. You will only be able to compete in *one* of these four competitions. Attempting to register for more than one of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted. ## Registration Reminder You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ## Mailing List We are aware of the extremely high demand for competitions in Ontario. We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand and are regularly planning and announcing more and larger competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](http://speedcubingcanada.org) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. Thank you for your patience during this time as we work to scale up to the exciting growth of the cubing community. ## Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information: We're excited to welcome new and experienced cubers to Nanaimo, B.C., for the Nanaimo Swing into Spring 2023 cubing competition. Our [last competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NanaimoBacktoSchool2022) was a great success and we are looking forward to seeing you all again. Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website**. Note: there is of course the possibility that we will need to increase safety precautions. **Please be aware that changes may be needed.** An email will be sent out to registered competitors about significant changes if any are needed. We look forward to a full house of 110 competitors! Spectators can attend for free. Being mindful of space, we ask that no competitor brings more than 2 guests. You **only need to show up for the events that you're competing in** - but we encourage you to show up for longer. For example, if you're only competing in events that are on Saturday, then you don't need to come on Sunday. Finally, please note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, particularly for events in the afternoon **please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case. To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz). Unsubscribe at any time.

items.name: Save Ramir Cubing Kazakhstan 2023
items.information: Соревнование проводится с благотворительной целью. Все вырученные средства пойдут в помощь сбору средств на лечение 3-летнего ребенка с инвалидностью Рамира Ковалевского, с диагнозом «Спинальная мышечная атрофия 2 типа», который нуждается в самом дорогостоящем лекарственном препарате в мире, ZOLGENSMA. Главный спонсор соревнования – компания «Леовит». Соревнование проводится при поддержке школы №157 и общественного фонда «Alem Asar».. Смотрите наш аккаунт в Instagram (https://instagram.com/almaty_cubers), чтобы узнавать новости и подробную информацию о соревновании! Соревнование будет проходить в спортзале школы №157. Будем рады видеть вас на соревновании! Жарыс қайырымдылық мақсатында өткізеді. Жарыстан бүкіл түскен қаражат спиналды бұлшық атрофия диагнозына шалдыққан мүгедекке 3 жасар бала Рамир Ковалевскийге әлемде ең бағалы дәрі «ZOLGENSMA» сатып алу үшін қаржы жинауға және көмектесуге бағыттайды Жарыстың бас демеушісі – «Леовит» компаниясы. Жарыс мектептiң №157 мен «Alem Asar» қоғамдық қорының көмегiмен өткiзіледi. Біздің Instagram аккаунтымыздың парақшасында (https://instagram.com/almaty_cubers) жаңалықтар және жарыс туралы ақпарат көре аласыздар! Жарыс мектептің №157 спорт залында өткізіледі. Сіздің жарысқа белсенді ат салысып қатысқаныңызға қуаныштымыз! The competition is organised for charity. All the proceeds made from the competition will be spent for fundraising for helping 3-years old kid, Ramir Kovalevsky, in his spinal muscular atrophy medical treatment to purchase him the most expensive cure in the world, ZOLGENSMA. The Leovit company is the main sponsor of the competition. The competition is organised with the help of school #157 and Alem Asar social foundation. Watch our posts in our Instagram account (https://instagram.com/almaty_cubers) to learn the news and more information about the competition! The competition will be set in the sports hall of the school #157. We will be happy to see you at the competition!

items.name: Vardagscubing IV - Gamla Uppsala 2023
items.information: Varmt välkommen till den fjärde svenska upplagan av Vardagscubing, denna gång i Uppsala! Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 21 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Notera dock att varje deltagare denna gång **får välja maximalt fem (5) grenar** att tävla i. Tävlingen, som denna gång går på en **tisdag** pågår endast i drygt 3 timmar. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida (särskilt "Vardagscubing") så du inte missar någon viktig information. **OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen. -- Welcome to the fourth Swedish edition of Vardagscubing, this time in Uppsala! The competition has a very special format, where each competitor has a total of 21 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. Note, however, that each competitor this time **can choose a maximum of five (5) events** to compete in. The competition, which this time takes place on a **Tuesday**, lasts only roughly 3 hours. items.information: ##### *English version is below* #### **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr euch Vienna Fasching 2023 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, David Dinh, Jeremia Neuhold und delegiert von Bence Barát. Erneut findet das Turnier im großen Saal der Akkonplatz Pfarre statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! ----- #### **English:** We are happy to announce the Vienna Fasching 2023 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, David Dinh, Jeremia Neuhold and delegated by Bence Barát. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.information: # This competition takes place on a Sunday. Please plan accordingly. All competitors should read the Competitor Responsibilities and COVID-19 Safety tab before registering There is no mask policy at the venue, but we still encourage anyone that wishes to wear one to do so. If the situation regarding COVID-19 worsens, masks may become a requirement closer to the competition. **How to Change/Cancel Your Registration** Competitors can change or cancel by emailing the organization team with the following information: 1. Intent to change/cancel registration 2. Desired changes to registration 3. Name (and WCA ID, if applicable) of the competitor. Competitors can also modify their registration through the Register tab. In the event that a competitor cancels their registration, they will only receive a 75% refund ($18.75 USD). The deadline to change/cancel your registration is Feburary 4th , 2023, 5:00 PM Mountain Time. **Waitlist Procedure** If registration fills up, we will place competitors on a waitlist. In the event a competitor drops from the competition, competitors will be accepted from the waitlist in the order we receive payment. Competitors can be accepted from the waitlist until Feburary 4th, 2022 at 5:00 PM MST. You will receive a full refund if you are still on the waitlist by then.

items.information: Kick off the 2023 cubing season in Gauteng with a two day competition in Centurion. ### VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". If you are a new competitor who is competing in any events on Saturday, please speak to a delegate who will show you how to compete and perform the above duties. We also recommend that you take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). ### SPONSOR [CubeCo](https://cubeco.co.za/) is sponsoring this competition, and will be offering cubes for sale on the day. ### About CubingZA Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. items.name: Vardagscubing III - Ålidenskolan Open B 2023
items.information: Varmt välkommen till den tredje svenska upplagan av Vardagscubing, i samarbete med Ålidenskolan i Flen! Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 18 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Tävlingen, som hålls på en **fredag**, pågår endast i 3,5 timmar. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida (särskilt "Vardagscubing") så du inte missar någon viktig information. **OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen. **OBS:** Notera att du bara får anmäla dig till (och delta på) en av de två tävlingarna som hålls i Flen denna dag. -- A warm welcome to the third Swedish edition of Vardagscubing, in collaboration with Ålidenskolan in Flen! The competition has a very special format, where each participant has a total of 18 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. The competition, which this time takes place on a **Friday**, lasts only 3,5 hours. Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Vardagscubing") so you don't miss any important information. **N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition. **N.B:** Note that you may only register for (and participate in) one of the two competitions held in Flen that day.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

items.name: Vardagscubing II - Hive A 2022
items.information: Välkommen till Vardagscubing II - Hive A 2022, som hålls i centrala Stockholm. Detta är din chans att bli av med de extra kalorierna från julmaten de närmasta dagarna innan tävlingen! Alla är varmt välkomna att tävla, men vänligen läs igenom alla flikar på denna sida för att se till att du inte missar någon viktig information om tävlingen. ### Vänligen notera: * **3x3x3 FMC kan inte kombineras med någon annan gren. 4x4x4 BLD och 5x5x5 BLD kan inte kombineras med 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (och vice versa).** * **Varje deltagare får ta med högst en gäst till denna tävling. Varje gäst måste betala en inträdesavgift på 30 SEK för att få komma in i lokalen.** Läs "extra registration requirements" för mer information. * **Lokalen ligger i en kontorsarbetsplats med hög fysisk säkerhet och du kommer inte att kunna komma och gå som du vill.** Du måste antingen anlända till ytterdörren senast fem minuter innan den första grenen ska starta, eller ge dig själv gott om tid innan din första gren för att se till att någon har tid att släppa in dig. Information om telefonnummer till utvalda Hive Streaming-anställda kommer att mailas till dig dagen innan tävlingen, i fall du behöver ringa någon för att släppa in dig på kontoret. * **Notera att du bara får anmäla dig till (och delta på) en av de två tävlingarna som hålls i Stockholm denna dag.** --- Welcome to Vardagscubing II - Hive A 2022, held in downtown Stockholm. This is your chance to work off some of those extra calories from the Christmas food of the past few days! Everyone is warmly welcome to compete, but please read through all tabs on this site to make sure you don't miss any important information about the competition. ### Please note: * **3x3x3 FMC can not be combined with any other event. 4x4x4 BLD and 5x5x5 BLD can not be combined with 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (and vice versa).** * **Every competitor can bring at most one guest to this competition. Every attending guest will have to pay an entry fee of 30 SEK to be allowed inside the venue.** Please read the extra registration requirements for more information. * **The venue is an office workplace with a high level of physical security, and you will not be able to come and go as you please.** You must either arrive at the front door no later than five minutes before the first event is scheduled to start, or give yourself ample time before your first event to make sure that someone can find the time to let you in. Details of contact phone numbers to selected Hive Streaming employees will be emailed to you the day before the competition, in case you need to call someone to let you in to the office. * **Note that you may only register for (and participate in) one of the two competitions held in Stockholm that day.**

items.information: New Zealand Nationals 2022 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. In addition, New Zealand Nationals 2022 will crown the National Champions in 16 WCA official events, over the course of 3 days.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. O uso de máscaras é recomendado! Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. items.name: Vardagscubing I - Uppsala 2022
items.information: Varmt välkommen till den första svenska upplagan av Vardagscubing, denna gång i Uppsala! Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 20 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Tävlingen, som denna gång går på en **måndag** pågår endast i 4 timmar. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida (särskilt "Vardagscubing") så du inte missar någon viktig information. **OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen. -- Welcome to the first Swedish edition of Vardagscubing, this time in Uppsala! The competition has a very special format, where each participant has a total of 20 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. The competition, which this time takes place on a **Monday**, lasts only 4 hours. Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Vardagscubing") so you don't miss any important information. **N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition.

items.information: **Svenska** Välkommen till Östersund och den första tävlingen i Jämtland någonsin! Vi påminner om att alla är varmt välkomna, vare sig du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Vi rekommenderar att du läser all information på sidan så du inte missar någon viktig information. Tävlingen är schemalagd så att om du inte deltar i 3x3 med Ögonbindel, Clock, Megaminx, 6x6, 7x7 eller 3x3 med en Hand behöver du inte vara närvarande förrän 14:45 på lördagen. **English** Welcome to the first competition in Jämtland ever! We remind you that everyone is welcome, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes. We recommend that you read all the information on this page to not miss any important information. The competition is scheduled so that if you don’t compete in 3x3 Blindfolded, Clock, Megaminx, 6x6, 7x7 or 3x3 One-Handed, you won’t have to be present until 2:45 PM on Saturday.

items.information: Kilpailupaikalla saa olla yhtä aikaa maksimissaan 150 ihmistä. Jokainen kilpailija saa tuoda mukanaan yhden vieraan. Kilpailijoille ja heidän mukana tuleville vieraille jaetaan kaulanauhat. Paikalle saa tulla muita katsojia kunhan tilassa ei ole enempää kuin 150 ihmistä kerrallaan. Mikäli järjestyksenvalvoja huomauttaa väkimäärästä, paikalta voidaan poistaa niitä joilla ei ole kaulanauhaa. At the venue there can be simultaneously 150 people at most. Every competitor may bring one guest with them. Competitors and their guests are given badges. Everyone else is welcome to the venue at all times as long as no more than 150 people is present at once. In case security officer notifys that there could be too many people those without badges could be denied entry to the venue.

All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs. **Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending Kewbz UK Championship 2022, you'll receive a completely free UK Championship t-shirt as a memento! You will receive this on registration at the venue, where you can choose your size. **Guests:** Guests will **only** be permitted to attend by paying a **£5** fee **at the competition**. Competitors will receive lanyards, and their guests and spectators will receive wristbands, which are to be worn throughout the weekend for security reasons. **This includes parents/guardians of competitors.** The fee must be paid at the competition and cannot be prepaid beforehand. The guest field in the registration form is for informational purposes only, the fee must be paid at the competition. **Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements in an official WCA competition by *17th October 2022*, you will not be eligible to compete in those events. Please see the **Events** tab to see these requirements. Please note that **new competitors can only compete in 3x3, 2x2, Skewb and Pyraminx**. **Final Round Advancements:** For all events with more than one round we will be taking a minimum number of UK competitors to the final. If necessary, we will increase the size of the final by one competitor at a time until we have enough UK competitors. The requirements are as follows: 2x2, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1 - 6 UK competitors; 3x3 - 8 UK competitors. 3x3 Multiple Blindfolded has a Top 16 qualification requirement, similarly this must contain at least 6 UK competitors. **Fewest Moves:** FMC will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at [Kewbz UK Championship FMC 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKChampionshipFMC2022) on 22nd October instead. The winner of the FMC competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Kewbz UK Championship 2022. We will be taking videos and photographs of the competition and the environment for our social media pages and website. Media persons will also be in attendance. By attending the competition as a competitor or a guest, you are accepting that you may be filmed or photographed for these purposes. **Please Note:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete. [![Kewbz](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/679033331912015892/1005532291797352509/RGB_FINAL_UKC_2022_LOGO_FOR_SCREENS.png)](https://kewbz.co.uk)

items.information: Välkomna till Svenska Mästerskapen 2022! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 7 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Det blir i år en 2,5-dagarstävling med alla WCA-grenar utom en, 3x3x3 FMC. Den Svenska Mästaren i den grenen kommer krönas på den separata tävlingen [Swedish FMC Championship 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2022). Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. Tävlande av alla nationaliteter är välkomna, men bara deltagare som representerar Sverige kan vinna medaljer, priser och titeln Svensk Mästare. *Notera vänligen också att klockan ställs* ***tillbaka*** *en timme till vintertid i Sverige natten mot söndag den 30:e oktober, vilket betyder en timmes längre sömn!* ----- Welcome to the Swedish Championship 2022! Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 7 seconds or 5 minutes. This year there will be a 2,5-day competition with all WCA events but one, 3x3x3 FMC. The Swedish Champion in this event will be crowned at the separate competition [Swedish FMC Championship 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2022). We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. Competitors of all nationalities are welcome, but only participants representing Sweden can win medals, prizes and the title of Swedish Champion. *Please also note that the clock is set* ***back*** *one hour to winter time in Sweden on the night before Sunday October 30th, which means an hour more sleep!*

items.information: ##### *English version is below* #### **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr euch Vienna Open 2022 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, Alexander Helbok, Sanio Kasumovic und delegiert von Niko Ronkainen. Diesmal findet das Turnier im großen Saal der Akkonplatz Pfarre statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Falls Ihr Gäste dabei habt, würden wir euch bei der Anmeldung im Kommentarfeld um die Namen eure Gäste bitten. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! ----- #### **English:** We are happy to announce the Vienna Open 2022 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, Alexander Helbok, Sanio Kasumovic and delegated by Niko Ronkainen. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. If you bring any guests, please write their names in the comments of your registration.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador (conforme previsto no Regulamento da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. --------------------------------------------------------------- Registration is open to all, of all nationalities. Aiming at the smooth running of the competition, when registering, you also make yourself available to help as a judge or scrambler (as stated in the WCA Regulations). This is a way for the competition to become sustainable, and the tasks are shared between all competitors, not becoming a heavy load just for a few.
